reviews.text:
I have an American Akita who can be wary and protective around strangers in our home, so finding reliable care for him has become increasingly difficult as he gets older. To clarify, he isn’t outwardly aggressive in public or toward other dogs. His reactions are generally related to his personal space being invaded or people approaching him too quickly before he has a chance to feel comfortable. He needs time to warm up to people, a groomer who understands his need for a muzzle, and caregivers who are patient enough to earn his trust and respect his boundaries. Traditional pet sitting just wasn’t working well for us anymore, and I honestly thought I was running out of options until I found this place.

They were willing to give him a chance, and I couldn’t be more grateful. We scheduled a handling evaluation, and not only did he pass, but the staff had wonderful things to say about how well he did! I’ve always believed my dog understands the difference between being at home, at the vet, and in a boarding environment. I think he can sense when people are simply there to care for him and take him outside without pushing his boundaries or making him uncomfortable. Still, I know his positive experience wouldn’t have been possible without -professionals- who understand how to handle a strong-willed, protective breed like the American Akita.

What means the most to me is that they got to see the dog I know and love: the sweet, loyal dog who sometimes just needs a little extra understanding and patience. He had done well boarding when he was under a year old, but now that he’s almost three, I wasn’t sure how he would handle it. I honestly thought it could go either way, but they said he did just fine.

Even when we first walked in, I could tell he was calm, almost as if he knew this was a place where he could feel comfortable. I’m so relieved and thankful to have found a team that sees his potential, respects his needs, and understands the importance of giving him the time and space he needs to feel safe. It gives me such peace of mind knowing he can be cared for by people who understand him rather than judge him by his breed or his protective instincts.

I can’t thank them enough for giving him a chance and giving me hope that boarding can be a positive experience for him. Finding a place where my dog is understood, respected, and welcomed means the world to me.
My boy loves it here. Very excited to visit. He's always good and worn out when we pick him up. Staff is friendly and take good care of the animals.
130lb Rottie requires enhanced care imo, they handle everything under the sun no problem!
My dog loves it here!!

My puppy was rejected from this facility due to being timid. They determined she was not a fit for this facility because she timid and not comfortable in a new environment. A loud environment with high stimulation once you get to the back side where the dog kennels are. The dog handler decided because my dog was nervous about being taken around with a stranger without getting to know or acclimate to that stranger (s) that after 6 hours she was not worth worry or work. A puppy in a new environment scared and not understand quite what was going on was turned away from ‘professional’ handlers with over decades of experience because they weren’t capable of understanding a dog who just needed a little more time to get to know them, so if you’re dog is young and still learning the world this isn’t the place for your fur baby.
The staff themselves were kind which is why this isn’t a one star review. But patient they are not
A pet hotel I would love to stay at!! I dropped my boy there and was jealous of him. He enjoyed the stay.

Our dog had a great stay at Philadelphia Pet Hotel and Villas. He can get pretty bad separation anxiety but was comfortable and at ease! He enjoyed his group play time, ate as normal and was relaxed. The staff are all friendly, helpful and professional. Loved that we could bring his dog bed to make him more comfortable. Definitely would recommend!

I have now had 4 pets stay there over the years (3 different dogs and 1 cat) and I cannot believe I have not yet left a review.  I have utilized their services for long stays and I have always felt at ease.  There is excellent communication and I feel confident leaving my animals in their care.  Of course, I prefer to take my dogs with me, whenever and wherever I can, but sometimes circumstances do not allow.  This is the next best thing.  If you're on the fence between here and somewhere else, BOOK HERE!
Love Pet Hotel. My Ms. Pepper is always sad to go home.

I like this place, just a little expensive for me.  They gave a price of $85 a night so I assumed everything else was included as far as walking the dogs and some type of interaction but actually it's about $120 per day and a wash is $75. I have a large dog but a gentle giant. The staff is very nice and understanding and facility is very clean.

They're proactive and care about making our dog comfortable and happy while we're away.

We drive hours out of the way to board our pup here because we trust them and it's worth it!

They're daily updates give us peace of mind that she's getting all the love. Their attention to detail during group play to ensure everyone's safety and enjoyment is, in our experience, unparalleled. They understand dogs and set them up to succeed.

They're truly the best.

This is the best dog boarding in Philly. We highly recommend it and have boarded our dog for 4 years. Our Aussie is a lot to handle (he has anxiety and doesn’t do well with other dogs) but he actually likes going here. The staff are incredibly kind, clearly love the dogs, and always make us feel like he’s in good hands. It’s the only place we truly trust to take care of him, and we can’t recommend them enough.

I've had some mixed experience boarding my dogs in the past, and so I had a lot of questions about safety and health when I called the first time. Daren literally spent over half an hour talking me through everything and explaining their policies and procedures. My 2 year old has stayed there three times now, and she's always excited to go. They have lots of options for dogs who need one on one attention instead of group play, and it's well worth paying a bit more than I would elsewhere to know that my puppy is being treated extremely well.

--Nina

Philadelphia Pet Hotel & Villas and their entire team have been the most amazing second family to our dog and cat across the nine years we have been boarding with them. The staff is kind, generous of spirit, and 1000% dedicated to the health, wellbeing, and joy of our pets while in their care. We were never on a trip and worried about them- peace of mind with a trustworthy and caring boarding team is worth every penny! Can’t recommend enough.
The best!!!!

Visited Philly by way of Baltimore. Was easily able to book accomodations via phone. The staff during check in was incredible & took great care of my puppo, who is a bit of an anxious boy. During check out I got a full report of how my dog was during each day of his stay. I even got a written report of his group play activities! They also washed my dogs bed and his favorite toy, without me requesting it or being charged for it!

This place is also unique in that they have staff on site 24/7 & a pet hospital near by. Would highly recommend!!
We LOVE them! They are SO great to our 15 year old pup and SUPER accommodating!!

Made a last minute reservation here due to my husky tearing her acl right before our family vacation. They were able to accommodate her extra needs of patient walks and limited off leash play that many other facilities could not. They were also very patient and professional with my aussie who can be reactive at first around strangers. They took excellent care of my pups and updated me on how they were doing. All their belongings also came home squeaky clean. Would absolutely recommend and they'll be seeing my pups again!

I cannot recommend these people enough. they are as dog-crazy as I am and that is a hard thing to accomplish. I feel so secure and comfortable when they watch my dogs. I love getting the photo updates -- they write a lot and send loads of photos! I love seeing my dogs have such fun and get kisses from the staff. The staff is well trained in dog handling and managing dog playgroups. They really get to know the dogs in their care. They are really easy to reach via email which is really convenient for me!

One of the most notable aspects of this place is that the owners are actively involved in everything that happens, work very hard to ensure high-quality care, and treat your dogs like their own. The staff form relationships with the dogs to the point that they all remember each other. We've had our dogs stay with them many times and have found it to be convenient and accommodating. Although I have never personally stayed in the kennels, they seem nice, and the sizing is thoughtful. One unique aspect of their offering is the variety of socialization options available for the dogs. After more extended stays, our dogs behave a bit better on walks and in general.

We’ve been boarding our dog here for years. He gets insanely excited when he sees or hears his to go bags getting ready. He bolts across the parking lot, towing me behind, to get in the doors. He then loves to loudly announce his arrival.

The owners and staff are true animal lovers. He gets his walks, playtime and lots of love during his stay. We get a full report of his stay at checkout to know how he ate, drank and bathroom habits.

I greatly appreciate the staff calling with any concerns. Our phone calls always begin with don’t worry your baby is fine and then what they’ve noticed. We’re able to decide on a plan, whether it’s a follow up with our vet or a trip the vet next door.

I can’t recommend this place enough!!!! They are so tentative, kind, and truly love their doggy guests. We feel so secure knowing we can leave our pups there to have fun and be safe. They proactively communicate with us while we’re away with updates and the funniest pictures. Every stay has been 10/10 for us + our dogs!

It was my first time here and they were good with my two small dogs. Very thorough with explanations and we did a trial day before their actual check in - so that we’d see if the dogs would be a good fit. I was able to put them in the same room and keep them together. They called me with an update and left a message for me. My one dog is part Chihuahua with some behavior issues and they were able to accommodate him just fine. They came back happy and safe. The staff is very friendly and they treat you with a lot of understanding. I was able to bring some things from home to leave with the dogs for comfort items. I was very nervous leaving them but they eased all of my worries. Thanks !
Dr. Morgan Agnew most amazing repro specialist!!
They give excellent care there .
The best Pet hotel in Philadelphia, professional pet services and cares. Pet owners life savers!
This place is a true home away from home for our dog Roxy!!! Staff are all so friendly and truly love animals! Roxy loves the homemade meatballs too!!!

I recently boarded my dog here for around a week. It was my dogs first time boarding and I was super nervous leaving him by himself since he's also a little reactive to other dogs. But the staff here were so kind and accommodating to our needs and my dog had no issues while staying here. Will definitely be coming back here to board my dog and recommending this place to my friends!
My family has been using the PHL pet hotel since 2015.  Very fair pricing and great supporters of law enforcement working dogs.  STRONG work going on there
This is the only kennel I trust. They took incredible care of my puppy. He didn't want to leave! They are simply the best.
